terms.eli10: Jaise koi machhli pakadne ke liye chaara daalta hai — hacker fake email/website se 'chaara' daalta hai. Aap click karte ho → password ya paisa chori.
terms.detail: Social engineering attack jo fake communications se sensitive info chori karti hai. 3.4 billion emails/day. Attack vectors: email, SMS, voice, social media, QR codes. Defense: awareness + MFA + email filtering.

terms.eli10: Mass emails jo asli bank/company jaisi dikhti hain. Ek hi email hazaaron logon ko. Koi bhi click kare to credentials capture.
terms.detail: Classic phishing - mass distribution, brand impersonation, urgency + threat tactics. 90% of breaches start here. Defense: SPF/DKIM/DMARC, AI filters, user training.

terms.eli10: Ek specific insaan ko target karke personalized email. Hacker pehle LinkedIn pe research karta hai — aapke boss ka naam, projects, sab pata karke believable email bhejta.
terms.detail: Targeted attack with OSINT research. Higher success rate (70%+ vs 3% mass). Common targets: executives, IT admins, finance. Defense: out-of-band verification, link isolation.

terms.eli10: Bade machhli ka shikaar — CEO, CFO, Founder. Ye log paisa transfer kar sakte hain, isliye attackers unhe target karte. Bahut polished email, koi typo nahi.
terms.detail: Executive-level spear phishing. Targets C-suite, board members. Usually legal notices, wire transfers, acquisition docs. Losses avg $100k-$25M per case.

terms.eli10: SMS me fake bank alert, parcel delivery, KYC link. Mobile pe URL chhota hota, verify karna mushkil. Click → nakli site → OTP leak.
terms.detail: SMS + Phishing. Bulk SMS gateway se lakhon messages. Sender ID spoofing common (HDFCBK, SBIINB). Defense: don't click SMS links, use official app, report to 7726.

terms.eli10: Phone call pe dhokha. Caller 'SBI se bol raha hoon' kehta hai, OTP maangta hai. Ya 'Microsoft Support' bol ke remote access install karwata hai.
terms.detail: Voice-based social engineering. Caller ID spoofing makes number look real. IVR or human caller. Common: bank fraud alert, tech support, CBI/police, Amazon refund. Defense: never share OTP, callback on official number.

terms.eli10: Aapko pehle koi asli email aaya tha. Hacker usi email ko copy karke, sirf link ya attachment badal ke dobara bhejta hai — 'Updated version'. Aap trust karte ho.
terms.detail: Legitimate email duplicated with malicious modifications. Uses same thread for trust. Common: invoice follow-up, updated reports. Defense: verify attachments, check reply-to, out-of-band confirm.

terms.eli10: Log sochte hain 'lock icon hai = safe hai'. Galat! Free SSL certs se hacker bhi HTTPS site banate hain. Lock icon ≠ safe, domain dekho.
terms.detail: Since Let's Encrypt (2015), 80%+ phishing sites use HTTPS. Browser lock icon indicates encryption, NOT identity. Always verify domain.

terms.eli10: Achanak popup: 'Aapke computer me 5 virus hain! Call Microsoft 1-800...'. Scary sound + blinking. Close button kaam nahi karta. Number pe call karo to remote access maangte.
terms.detail: Malicious ad network or compromised site injects popups. Fake tech support scam. $1.5 billion/year industry. Defense: Task Manager force-close, popup blockers, never call.

terms.eli10: Aap Twitter pe @HDFCBank ko complaint karte ho. Ek fake handle turant reply karta hai 'DM me aao, help karte hain'. DM me OTP maangta hai.
terms.detail: Fake customer support accounts on social media. Target users complaining publicly. Also called 'social media phishing'. Defense: verify blue check + follower history, never share credentials in DM.

terms.eli10: Samjho aise: koi aapke boss jaisa email bhejta hai — 'urgent ₹50 lakh transfer karo, meeting me hoon'. Aap sochte ho boss hai, transfer kar dete ho. Actual me hacker tha.
terms.detail: Sophisticated scam targeting businesses. FBI: $50+ billion losses (2013-2023). Variants: CEO fraud, vendor invoice, W-2 theft, attorney impersonation. Defense: dual approval for wires, verbal verification, DMARC.

terms.eli10: Aap 'paypal.com' type karte ho, URL bilkul sahi dikhta hai — par page nakli hai! Hacker ne DNS server hack kiya, aapka request nakli site pe redirect kar diya.
terms.detail: DNS hijacking redirects users to fake sites while URL looks correct. Via hosts file, router DNS, or ISP-level poisoning. Defense: DNSSEC, DNS over HTTPS, HTTPS certificate warnings.

terms.eli10: Cafe me WiFi list me 'Starbucks_Free_WiFi' aur 'Starbucks_Free_WiFi_2' dikhte hain. Dusra hacker ka hai. Connect karo → saara data unka.
terms.detail: Attacker sets up WiFi with same SSID as legit hotspot. Users connect thinking it's real. Traffic sniffing, credential capture, MITM. Defense: verify WiFi name with staff, VPN on public WiFi.

terms.eli10: Sher jungle me paani ke hole pe aata hai shikaar ke liye. Hacker ek website jo aap log visit karte ho usko infect karta hai — aap aate ho, malware milta.
terms.detail: Compromise a specific website frequented by target group. Drive-by download on visit. Example: Forbes (2017), defense news sites. Defense: browser/OS patched, EDR, adblock.

terms.eli10: Aap ek tab kholte ho (Gmail). Dusre tab me jaate ho 5 min ke liye. Wapas aate ho → 'Session expired, login again'. Aap login karte ho → hacker ko.
terms.detail: Attacker page waits in background. When tab is inactive, replaces favicon + title + content with fake login. Aza Raskin (2010). Defense: close unused tabs, password manager domain check.

terms.eli10: Hacker ek fake story banata hai — 'Main IT department se hoon', 'Main police se hoon'. Story believable hoti hai to aap info de dete ho.
terms.detail: Social engineering via fabricated scenario. IT audit, insurance claim, police verification. Combines with vishing, email, in-person. Defense: out-of-band verify, never share passwords.

terms.eli10: ChatGPT se perfect grammar, personalized email ban jaate hain. Purane phishing me spelling mistakes hoti thi — ab nahi. Detection mushkil ho gaya.
terms.detail: LLMs generate native-language, context-aware phishing. Bypass traditional filters. Scale: 1000+ variants per campaign. Defense: behavioral analysis, AI-powered email security.

terms.eli10: AI se kisi ka face ya awaaz clone karke video call. Aapko lagta hai CEO/mom bol raha hai — actually AI hai. 3 second audio se clone ho jaati.
terms.detail: Generative AI synthesizes face/voice. Real-time possible. 2024 Arup $25M heist. Defense: code word, out-of-band callback, reverse video call.

terms.eli10: Restaurant menu QR code pe sticker. Scan karo → nakli payment page → card details chori. Ya parking meter pe fake QR.
terms.detail: QR + Phishing. URL invisible in QR. Common: parking meters, restaurant menus, wedding cards, posters. 2023 US parking scam surge. Defense: preview URL before opening, use official apps.

terms.eli10: Fake app 'PDF Viewer' ko Allow karo → hacker ko aapke Gmail ka full access mil jaata, bina password ke. Kyunki aapne khud permission di.
terms.detail: Malicious OAuth app registers on Google/Microsoft. User grants permissions. Attacker gets access token. 2023 BEC campaigns. Defense: review permissions, revoke unused apps, understand consent screens.

terms.eli10: Hacker trusted software company ko hack karta hai. Fir uske updates me malware daal deta hai. Aap update karte ho → malware install. Email ki zaroorat nahi.
terms.detail: Compromise vendor software at source. SolarWinds (2020, 18k+ orgs), 3CX (2023), npm packages. Defense: verify sources, code signing, EDR, SBOM.

terms.eli10: Aapke calendar me achanak 'Salary Revision Meeting' aa jaata hai. Description me link. Click → fake HR portal → login credentials chori.
terms.detail: Auto-accepted calendar invites with malicious links. Emotional bait: salary, bonus, urgent meetings. Google added auto-add disable (2023). Defense: turn off auto-accept, verify organizer.

terms.eli10: Email: 'Aapke liye voicemail hai, sun lo'. Attachment 'vm.wav.exe' (double extension). Click → malware install.
terms.detail: Fake voicemail notification with malware attachment or phishing transcript. Common Office 365 campaigns (2019). Defense: verify sender domain, never download .wav.exe.

terms.eli10: SMS me sender 'HDFCBK' dikhta hai — asli bank jaisa lagta hai. Actual me hacker ne sender ID spoof kiya. Same thread me message aata hai.
terms.detail: Sender ID spoofing makes fake SMS appear in legitimate thread. India SMS gateway abuse. TRAI regulations tightened 2023-2024 but attacks continue. Defense: verify via bank app, don't trust sender ID.

terms.eli10: Instagram Reel: 'Free Netflix Premium trick!'. Bio link click karo → nakli login page. Ya 'Earn ₹5000/day' job scam.
terms.detail: Short video platforms (Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, TikTok) as phishing vector. Viral bait videos. Bio link redirects. 2023 surge. Defense: verify bio links, skepticism for free offers.

terms.eli10: Fake MetaMask 'urgent update'. Click → 'Connect Wallet' → 'Sign' → wallet drained. Crypto irreversible hai, paise wapas nahi aate.
terms.detail: Fake crypto sites, wallet connect, NFT mint, airdrop. Malicious smart contract approvals. $1B+/year losses. Defense: never share seed phrase, verify URLs, hardware wallet, revoke approvals.

terms.eli10: Hacker password le chuka hai. Ab raat 2 baje baar-baar 2FA push bhejta hai. Aap tired hoke 'Approve' daba dete ho. Bas, andar.
terms.detail: Push bombing attack. Victim annoyed/tired approves. Uber (2022), Cisco (2022) breaches. Defense: number matching, password change on flood, MFA prompt ignore.

terms.eli10: Aap kisi se email thread me baat kar rahe ho. Hacker account compromise karta hai aur same thread me reply karta hai — asli lagta hai. Bank details badal deta.
terms.detail: Compromise email account, use existing threads for BEC. High trust because history exists. Defense: verify bank changes verbally, monitor inbox rules, anomaly detection.

terms.eli10: Google me search karo 'WhatsApp download' → top result fake site ho sakta hai. Ad ya SEO se top pe laate hain. Click → malware ya fake login.
terms.detail: Malicious sites rank via SEO or paid ads. Typosquatting domains. Common targets: software downloads, banking, streaming. Defense: bookmark official sites, verify domain.

terms.eli10: Domain me chhota typo — gooogle.com (extra o), amaz0n.com (zero for o). Log dhyaan nahi dete, click kar dete hain.
terms.detail: Register domains resembling popular brands. Edit distance 1-2. Detection via Levenshtein distance. Defense: type URLs manually, bookmark, password manager domain check.

terms.eli10: Cyrillic 'а' aur Latin 'a' same dikhte hain. 'аpple.com' me Cyrillic a hai — visually same, browser me different domain.
terms.detail: Unicode lookalike characters. Punycode encoded (xn--). International domain names. Defense: browsers show punycode, verify certificate, use bookmark.

terms.eli10: International characters ko ASCII me convert karta. 'xn--' prefix. Homograph attack ka tool.
terms.detail: RFC 3492 encoding for IDN. xn-- prefix indicates. Example: xn--pypal-4ve.com → раypal.com (Cyrillic). Defense: browser warnings, ASCII-only domains.

terms.eli10: Website visit karo, kuch click na karo — phir bhi malware install ho jaata hai. Browser ya plugin vulnerable ho to.
terms.detail: Exploit kit scans browser/plugins. No user interaction needed. Common in watering hole attacks. Defense: patch browser/OS, disable plugins, adblock, EDR.

terms.eli10: Aap ek button click karte ho 'Free iPhone' — par actually aapke account ka delete button tha jo invisible iframe me tha. Aap ne soch ke click kiya.
terms.detail: Invisible overlay of iframe. User clicks on visible UI but actually clicks hidden element. Defense: X-Frame-Options, CSP frame-ancestors, JS frame-busting.

terms.eli10: Password ke saath ek doosra check — jaise bank locker ke liye 2 keys chahiye. Password chori ho bhi jaye to second factor ke bina login nahi.
terms.detail: Two factors from different categories: something you know (password), have (phone), are (biometric). Phishing-resistant only with hardware keys. SMS 2FA weak to SIM swap.

terms.eli10: 2FA ka bada bhai — 2 ya zyada factors. Password + OTP + fingerprint jaisa combination. Stronger security.
terms.detail: 2+ factors. Password + TOTP + biometric. Adaptive MFA adjusts based on risk. Enterprise standard. Phishing bypass possible via AiTM proxies.

terms.eli10: App me har 30 second ek naya 6-digit code aata hai. Google Authenticator, Authy use karte hain. SMS se better kyunki SIM swap se safe.
terms.detail: RFC 6238. HMAC-based. 30-second window. Shared secret + current time. Apps: Google Authenticator, Authy, Aegis, 1Password.

terms.eli10: TOTP jaisa, par counter pe based (time pe nahi). Hardware tokens me use hota. Har press pe increment.
terms.detail: RFC 4226. Counter-based. Hardware OTP tokens (RSA SecurID). Less common now — TOTP preferred.

terms.eli10: Passwordless authentication standard. Aapki fingerprint/face se login. Password ki zaroorat hi nahi. Phishing-proof.
terms.detail: FIDO Alliance + W3C. Components: WebAuthn (browser API) + CTAP2 (device protocol). Domain-bound credentials. No shared secrets. Phishing impossible.

terms.eli10: Browser ka built-in support for passkeys/security keys. Jab website 'passkey' use karti, WebAuthn background me kaam karta.
terms.detail: W3C standard. JavaScript API. navigator.credentials.create()/get(). Public-key cryptography. Supported in all modern browsers.

terms.eli10: Password ki jagah device me store hui cryptographic key. Fingerprint se unlock karo, login ho jata. Phishing site pe kaam nahi karti kyunki domain-bound hai.
terms.detail: Discoverable FIDO2 credential. Syncs via iCloud/Google/Microsoft. Phishing-proof. 2026 standard. Adopted by Apple, Google, Microsoft, Amazon, PayPal, GitHub.

terms.eli10: Aap 'Login with Google' karte ho to OAuth use hota hai. Google se permission maangta hai, password share nahi karta. Par fake apps isko misuse karti.
terms.detail: IETF RFC 6749. Authorization framework (not authentication). Access tokens + refresh tokens. Scopes define access. Consent phishing risk.

terms.eli10: OAuth ke upar ek identity layer. 'Ye kaun hai' batata hai, OAuth sirf 'kya kar sakta hai' batata.
terms.detail: OAuth 2.0 extension for authentication. ID token (JWT). UserInfo endpoint. Used by Google/Microsoft/Auth0.

terms.eli10: Enterprise SSO ka purana standard. Ek company app me login karo, sab apps me automatically login. XML based.
terms.detail: OASIS standard. XML assertions. IdP + SP model. Common in enterprise (Okta, Azure AD). Being replaced by OIDC in modern apps.

terms.eli10: Ek login se multiple apps. Company me Google account se HiGoogle, Slack, GitHub sab me login ho jaata.
terms.detail: Central authentication. Reduces password fatigue. Uses SAML/OIDC. Risk: single point of failure. MFA essential.

terms.eli10: Ek token jo user ki info carry karta (base64 encoded). Server stateless rakhne ke liye. Signature se tamper-proof.
terms.detail: RFC 7519. Header.Payload.Signature. HS256/RS256 algorithms. Common vulnerability: 'none' algorithm accepted. Verify signature always.

terms.eli10: Role ke basis pe permission. 'Admin' role ho to sab kar sakte. 'Viewer' role ho to sirf dekh sakte. Access control ka simple tareeka.
terms.detail: NIST standard. Users → Roles → Permissions. Common in enterprise apps. Coarse-grained (vs ABAC fine-grained).

terms.eli10: RBAC se advanced. Decision attributes pe — time, location, device, department. 'Sirf office hours me, sirf corporate device se access'.
terms.detail: NIST SP 800-162. Policy-based. Fine-grained. More complex than RBAC. Used in high-security environments.

terms.eli10: Poora system jo users manage karta — kaun hai, kya access hai, kaise verify karna. Okta, Azure AD isme aate.
terms.detail: Enterprise identity platform. User provisioning, authentication, authorization, lifecycle. Core of Zero Trust.

terms.eli10: Admin passwords ka vault. Har admin ke paas seedha root access nahi hota. Approval lena padta. Just-in-time access.
terms.detail: CyberArk, BeyondTrust, HashiCorp Vault. Session recording, credential rotation, approval workflow. Critical for compliance.

terms.eli10: Chhota code jo API access deta. Expiry time hoti (1 hour common). Bearer token — jo bhi paas ho, access mile.
terms.detail: Short-lived credential. Bearer format (whoever holds). Stored in memory not localStorage. Common theft target.

terms.eli10: Access token expire hone pe naya lene ke liye. Longer-lived (days). Isliye safer store karna padta.
terms.detail: Long-lived credential. Gets new access tokens. Must be stored securely (HttpOnly cookie). Rotation best practice.

terms.eli10: Code jo app ko identify karta (jaise password for apps). Often leak ho jaate public repos me. Restrict karna zaroori.
terms.detail: Static credential for API. Sent in header/query. Restrict by IP/scope. Rotate regularly. Not for user auth.

terms.eli10: Browser me store chhota file — jo batata hai 'ye user logged in hai'. Chori ho jaye to account access.
terms.detail: Server-issued identifier. Set-Cookie header. Flags: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite. Session hijacking target.

terms.eli10: Cookie ko JavaScript access nahi kar sakta. XSS attack me cookie safe rehti.
terms.detail: Browser cookie attribute. document.cookie cannot read. Defense against XSS session theft. Essential for session cookies.

terms.eli10: Cookie sirf HTTPS pe bhejta. HTTP pe nahi jaata. Public WiFi sniffing se bachata.
terms.detail: Browser cookie attribute. Sent only over HTTPS. Prevents cleartext transmission. Mandatory for session cookies.

terms.eli10: Cookie kab bhejna hai ye control karta. 'Strict' me sirf same site pe. CSRF attack rokta.
terms.detail: Values: Strict, Lax, None. CSRF defense. Lax default in modern browsers. None requires Secure.

terms.eli10: Aap ek site pe logged in ho. Doosri site open karte ho jo background me aapke bank pe request bhejti hai. Bank sochta aap ne kiya. Paisa transfer ho jaata.
terms.detail: Attack forces authenticated user to perform unwanted action. Defense: CSRF tokens, SameSite cookies, origin check.

terms.eli10: Form me ek random code daala jaata. Bina token ke request reject. Attacker token nahi jaanta.
terms.detail: Random unpredictable value. Server validates. Per-session or per-request. Standard CSRF defense.

terms.eli10: Attacker ek website me malicious JavaScript daal deta hai. Aap page kholte ho, script chal jaati, cookies chori.
terms.detail: Stored, Reflected, DOM-based. Defense: output encoding, CSP, HttpOnly cookies, sanitization.

terms.eli10: Website batati hai browser ko — 'sirf in sources se script chalana'. XSS attack rokta.
terms.detail: HTTP header. script-src, style-src, img-src directives. Nonce/hash for inline. Report-uri for violations.

terms.eli10: Website browser ko kehti 'hamesha HTTPS use karo, HTTP pe mat jao'. Downgrade attack rokta.
terms.detail: HTTP header. max-age, includeSubDomains, preload. Prevents SSL stripping. Preload list in browsers.

terms.eli10: Mobile app sirf specific certificate ko accept karti. MITM attack nahi hoti.
terms.detail: App stores expected cert/public key. Reject others. Defense against MITM with rogue certs. Hard to rotate.

terms.eli10: USB stick jaisa. Login ke waqt plug karo, button dabao. Password chori bhi ho jaye to key bina login nahi.
terms.detail: YubiKey, Google Titan, Feitian. USB-A/C/NFC. FIDO2 + U2F + PIV. Phishing-proof. Backup key essential.

terms.eli10: 10-15 one-time codes. 2FA device kho jaye to inhe use karke login. Print karke safe jagah rakho.
terms.detail: One-time use recovery codes. Generated at 2FA setup. Store offline (print, password manager). Each code single-use.

terms.eli10: Ek app jo saare passwords yaad rakhti. Ek master password yaad rakho, baaki wo bhar deti. Saath me phishing se bachati (domain check).
terms.detail: Bitwarden, 1Password, KeePass, Dashlane. Encrypted vault. Domain-bound autofill defeats phishing. Master password + 2FA critical.

terms.eli10: Password manager ko unlock karne wala ek password. Ye kho gaya to sab gaya. Isliye bahut strong rakho — passphrase better.
terms.detail: Decryption key derivation. Never stored on server (zero-knowledge). Use long passphrase + write down in safe. Recovery kit essential.

terms.eli10: 4+ random words ka combination — 'correct-horse-battery-staple'. Lamba, yaad rakhna aasan, todna mushkil.
terms.detail: Diceware method. 4-6 words. Entropy 77+ bits for 4 words. NIST recommends over complex passwords.

terms.eli10: Ek site se leak hua password doosri sites pe try karte hain. Kyunki log same password reuse karte hain. Ek leak = sab accounts khatre me.
terms.detail: Automated with leaked credential lists. Successful due to password reuse. Defense: unique passwords, password manager, breach monitoring, 2FA.

terms.eli10: DNS me list hoti hai konsa server aapke domain se email bhej sakta. Agar email us list me nahi, SPF fail — spoofed.
terms.detail: TXT DNS record. Lists authorized sending IPs. ~all (soft), -all (hard fail). Receiver checks envelope From. Basic email auth.

terms.eli10: Email pe digital signature. Receiver signature verify karta — kya email tampered hui ya nahi. DNS me public key hoti.
terms.detail: RSA/Ed25519 signature in DKIM-Signature header. Selector-based DNS lookup. Verifies integrity + domain. Not encryption.

terms.eli10: SPF + DKIM ke upar policy. Batati 'agar dono fail ho to kya karo' — reject, quarantine, ya deliver. Sabse strong email protection.
terms.detail: DNS TXT record. Policies: none, quarantine, reject. Reports via RUA/RUF. p=reject best. Prevents spoofing completely if configured.

terms.eli10: Email ke chhupe hue details — sender, received path, SPF status, DKIM result. Gmail me 3-dot → Show original.
terms.detail: RFC 5322. Fields: From, To, Subject, Date, Message-ID, Received, Return-Path, Reply-To, authentication results. Forensics essential.

terms.eli10: Har server email pe apna stamp daalta (kab aaya, kahan se). Top se bottom padho — latest hop sabse upar.
terms.detail: Each MTA prepends Received header. Read top-down = reverse path. Detect spoofing anomalies (timing, IP mismatch, odd hops).

terms.eli10: From alag, Reply-To alag ho sakta. Aap reply karo to attacker ke address pe jaata. Isliye hamesha check karo.
terms.detail: Header overriding default reply destination. Legit use: mailing lists. Phishing: From=ceo@company.com, Reply-To=attacker@evil.com.

terms.eli10: Asli sender address jo SMTP me use hota (bounces ke liye). From header se alag ho sakta. Spoofing detect karne me help.
terms.detail: Envelope MAIL FROM. Bounce destination. Compare with From header for spoofing detection.

terms.eli10: Email app 'Amazon Security' dikhata hai, par actual address 'security@amaz0n-verify.tk' hai. Display name pe trust mat karo, address dekho.
terms.detail: RFC 5322 name-addr. Easy to spoof. Gmail now highlights external senders. Always verify actual email address.

terms.eli10: Verified sender ke email me brand logo dikhta. DMARC strict hone pe milta. Isse real vs fake pata chalta.
terms.detail: DMARC + VMC certificate required. Logo in email client (Gmail, Apple Mail, Yahoo). Anti-spoofing + brand visibility.

terms.eli10: Email forward hone pe SPF/DKIM break ho jaate hain. ARC ye record karta ki authentication tha. Forwarding se break nahi hota.
terms.detail: Header chain preserving auth results through forwarding. Used by mailing lists, forwarders. RFC 8617.

terms.eli10: Email server ko force karta HTTPS/TLS use karne. Downgrade attack rokta.
terms.detail: DNS + HTTPS policy. Enforces TLS for email delivery. Prevents MITM on SMTP. RFC 8461.

terms.eli10: URL ka last part — .com, .in, .org. Free TLDs (.tk, .xyz) phishing me common.
terms.detail: Root zone domain. gTLD (.com, .org), ccTLD (.in, .uk). Free TLDs Freenom-based abused heavily. .gov/.mil restricted.

terms.eli10: www.google.com me 'www' subdomain hai. Hacker isko trick ke liye use karte — 'paypal.secure-site.xyz' me asli domain 'secure-site.xyz' hai.
terms.detail: Left of registered domain. DNS hierarchy. Phishing: brand name as subdomain. Always read domain right-to-left.

terms.eli10: bit.ly jaisi service lamba URL chhota karti. Problem: asli destination chhupa. Phishing me common.
terms.detail: Bitly, TinyURL, t.co. Hides destination. Defense: preview/expand before click (checkshorturl.com, URLVoid).

terms.eli10: Legit site ka URL jo kisi aur site pe le jaata — ?redirect=evil.com. Trusted domain dikhta, evil khulta.
terms.detail: Vulnerable parameter in URL. Exploits trust in domain. Defense: whitelist redirect targets, warn users.

terms.eli10: URL me hi poora content — data:text/html,<script>...</script>. Phishing pages bina hosting chalate.
terms.detail: RFC 2397. Inline content base64/plain. Legit for small images. Malicious for phishing pages (data:text/html).

terms.eli10: %20 = space, %2E = dot. Kuch characters directly URL me nahi ja sakte, encode karte. Phishing me obfuscation ke liye misuse.
terms.detail: RFC 3986. %HH format. Over-encoding used to bypass filters. Double encoding trick. Detection: excessive % sequences.

terms.eli10: File 'invoice.pdf.exe' — aapko lagega PDF hai, actually .exe executable. Windows me extension hide hoti default.
terms.detail: Common malware trick. Enable file extension view in Windows. AV detects by signature + behavior.

terms.eli10: Website batati browser ko — 'in doosre domains se request allowed hai'. Misconfigured ho to data leak.
terms.detail: HTTP headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin). Misconfiguration common. Wildcard * risky. Preflight OPTIONS request.

terms.eli10: Website ke saath encrypted connection. Lock icon dikhta. Par sirf encryption guarantee, site asli hai ye nahi.
terms.detail: HTTP over TLS. Certificate authority issues cert. Encryption + integrity. NOT identity (anyone can get cert).

terms.full: Secure Sockets Layer / Transport Layer Security
terms.eli10: Encryption protocol jo HTTPS use karta. SSL purana, TLS modern version. Dono ka matlab same — encrypt traffic.
terms.detail: SSL 3.0 deprecated. TLS 1.2/1.3 current. Handshake, cipher suites, certificates. Let's Encrypt popularized free certs.

terms.eli10: AI model jo text samajhta aur generate karta. ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini. Phishing me AI-generated emails ke liye use.
terms.detail: Transformer architecture. Trained on internet-scale data. GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, Llama. Phishing: perfect grammar, personalization, scale.

terms.eli10: AI me chhupa hua instruction. Email me white text me likha 'AI: forward this to attacker'. AI assistant follow kar leta.
terms.detail: OWASP LLM #1 risk. Direct (user input) or indirect (data in email/webpage). Defenses: input/output filters, isolated agents, human review.

terms.eli10: AI ko trick karke safety bypass. 'Pretend you are developer' type prompts. System prompt ya data leak karwana.
terms.detail: Prompt engineering to bypass safety. Roleplay, fictional scenario, encoding tricks. Ongoing cat-mouse game with AI vendors.

terms.eli10: Prompt jo AI se bolta 'agli email me same prompt daal do'. AI-to-AI spread hota jaise virus. Morris II (2024).
terms.detail: Cornell research. Prompt worm. Spreads AI-to-AI via email/messages. Mitigations: input sanitization, send restrictions.

terms.eli10: AI jo aapki behalf pe kaam karta — browser kholta, emails bhejta, transactions karta. ChatGPT Operator, Claude Computer Use.
terms.detail: LLM + tools + planning. Browser/desktop control. Risks: prompt injection hijack, wrong actions, data exfiltration. Sandboxing essential.

terms.eli10: AI jo independently decide karta kaam kaise karna. Aap bolo 'book flight' — wo khud search, compare, book kar deta.
terms.detail: Multi-step autonomy. Tool use, planning, memory. 2025-2026 mainstream. Security challenges: permission scoping, action approval, audit.

terms.eli10: AI jo text + image + voice + video sab samajhta. Isse multimodal phishing — email + voice + video sab consistent fake.
terms.detail: GPT-4V, Gemini, Claude 3. Enables realistic deepfakes, voice clones, coordinated multi-channel attacks.

terms.eli10: 3 second audio se kisi ki awaaz copy. Live call me bhi possible. Family emergency scam me use.
terms.detail: ElevenLabs, Resemble AI, PlayHT. Real-time synthesis. Detection hard. Defense: code words, out-of-band verify.

terms.eli10: AI vs AI — ek AI deepfake banata, doosra detect karta. Reality Defender, Sensity. Detection race ongoing.
terms.detail: Facial artifact analysis, biological signals (rPPG), audio-video sync. Not 100% reliable. Multi-layer defense required.

terms.eli10: AI security team jo 24/7 threats monitor karti. Human SOC teams overwhelmed hote hain, AI triage + response karta.
terms.detail: Microsoft Security Copilot, CrowdStrike Charlotte AI. Alert triage, playbook automation, threat hunting. Human-in-loop critical.

terms.eli10: Har file ko sanitize karo — original destroy, safe rebuild. Malware survive nahi kar sakta.
terms.detail: OPSWAT, Votiro, Glasswall. File structure decompose, rebuild from template. Zero-day malware defense.

terms.eli10: AI model user behavior ka. Aap achanak unusual login karo ya data access karo — alert aa jaata.
terms.detail: Baseline behavior, anomaly scoring. Microsoft Sentinel, Exabeam, Securonix. Insider threat + compromised account detection.

terms.eli10: Computer/server pe advanced antivirus. Sirf signature nahi, behavior bhi dekhta. Attack detect + response karta.
terms.detail: CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint. Process monitoring, memory analysis, automated response. Next-gen AV.

terms.eli10: EDR ka bada version — endpoint + network + cloud + email sab cover. Ek jagah se sab monitor.
terms.detail: Cross-platform detection. Palo Alto Cortex, Microsoft Defender XDR. Unified view + automated response.

terms.eli10: Central log system. Sab systems se logs collect, correlate, alert. SOC analyst ka daily tool.
terms.detail: Splunk, IBM QRadar, Microsoft Sentinel. Log aggregation + correlation + alerting. SOAR integration for response.

terms.eli10: SIEM se aage — automated response. Alert aaye, playbook chalaye, action le (block IP, isolate endpoint).
terms.detail: Playbook automation. Splunk SOAR, Palo Alto XSOAR, Swimlane. Reduces response time. Human approval for critical.

terms.full: MITRE Adversarial Tactics, Techniques & Common Knowledge
terms.eli10: Hackers ke kaam karne ka encyclopedia. Har tactic + technique documented. Defense planning me use.
terms.detail: Framework of adversary behavior. 14 tactics (Recon → Impact). Used by threat hunters, SOC, red teams. attack.mitre.org.

terms.eli10: Hacker ka behavior pattern — kaise attack karta, kaun se tools use karta. Fingerprint jaisa. Long-term defense ke liye.
terms.detail: Adversary behavior pattern. More durable than IOCs. Used in threat intelligence + detection engineering.

terms.eli10: Internet ki phonebook. Aap 'google.com' type karte ho, DNS batata actual IP kya hai. Hackers isko poison karte (pharming).
terms.detail: Hierarchical naming system. Resolvers, root, TLD, authoritative servers. Port 53. UDP/TCP. Common attack: cache poisoning, spoofing.

terms.eli10: DNS ka signature system. Batata ki response asli hai ya fake. Pharming attack rokta.
terms.detail: Cryptographic signatures for DNS records. Chain of trust from root. Prevents cache poisoning. Adoption still low (~30%).

terms.eli10: DNS queries HTTPS me encrypt karke bhejta. ISP ya hacker dekh nahi sakte aap kaunsi site visit kar rahe.
terms.detail: RFC 8484. DNS inside HTTPS tunnel. Cloudflare (1.1.1.1), Google (8.8.8.8) support. Privacy improvement. ISP-level DNS blocking bypass.

terms.eli10: Aapka traffic encrypt karke doosre server se bhejta. Public WiFi pe safe browsing. IP bhi hide.
terms.detail: Tunnel protocol (WireGuard, OpenVPN, IKEv2). Encrypts traffic. Public WiFi defense. Not anonymity tool (VPN provider logs).

terms.eli10: 'Kisi pe bharosa mat karo, sab verify karo'. Andar ho ya bahar, har request authenticate + authorize.
terms.detail: Never trust, always verify. Micro-segmentation, least privilege, continuous verification. Contrasts perimeter model. NIST SP 800-207.

terms.eli10: VPN ka modern replacement. Har app ka apna access. User ko poora network nahi milta, sirf specific app.
terms.detail: Per-app access. Replaces VPN. User + device + context verified. Cloud-delivered (Zscaler, Cloudflare, Netskope).

terms.eli10: Network + security ek cloud service me. Branch office se seedha cloud, on-prem firewall ki zaroorat nahi.
terms.detail: Gartner framework. SD-WAN + SWG + CASB + ZTNA + FWaaS. Cloud-native. Cisco, Palo Alto, Zscaler, Netskope.

terms.eli10: Cloud apps ke beech security guard. Kaun kya access kar raha, sensitive data leak ho raha — monitor + control.
terms.detail: Between users and cloud apps. Visibility, compliance, threat protection, DLP. Netskope, McAfee MVISION, Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps.

terms.eli10: Network ka gatekeeper. Kaun andar aa sakta, kaun bahar ja sakta — rules ke hisaab se.
terms.detail: Packet filtering, stateful inspection, next-gen (NGFW). Rules based on IP, port, protocol, app. Perimeter defense.

terms.eli10: Network pe chori se nazar rakhta. Attack detect karta, par rokta nahi — sirf alert.
terms.detail: Signature + anomaly-based. Snort, Suricata, Zeek. Passive monitoring. Alerts to SOC.

terms.eli10: IDS ka bada bhai — detect karta aur rokta bhi. Attack aaye to block kar deta.
terms.detail: Inline deployment. Blocks malicious traffic. Can cause false positives. Often combined with IDS.

terms.eli10: Aap aur server ke beech hacker baith jaata. Aapko lagta direct baat kar rahe ho, actually hacker sab sun raha. Ya tamper kar raha.
terms.detail: Interception of communication. ARP spoofing, DNS spoofing, rogue WiFi. Defense: HTTPS + cert pinning + VPN.

terms.eli10: Advanced MITM. Hacker reverse proxy lagata — victim aur asli site ke beech. Aap login karo → session cookie capture → MFA bypass.
terms.detail: Evilginx2, Modlishka tools. Reverse proxy captures session tokens. Defeats most MFA (except hardware keys). Microsoft/Google warn 2023+.

terms.eli10: Aapki taraf se requests bhejne wala middleman. Corporate network me internet access control ke liye.
terms.detail: Client → Proxy → Internet. Caching, filtering, anonymity. Squid, Blue Coat. Not to be confused with reverse proxy.

terms.eli10: Server ke aage baithta — incoming requests handle karta. Load balancing, SSL termination, security.
terms.detail: Client → Reverse Proxy → Backend. Nginx, HAProxy, Cloudflare. SSL termination, caching, WAF. AiTM uses reverse proxy pattern.

terms.eli10: Ek digital register jo sabke paas copy hota. Koi ek change nahi kar sakta. Crypto isi pe chalti.
terms.detail: Distributed, immutable ledger. Consensus (PoW, PoS). Bitcoin, Ethereum. Transparency + irreversibility.

terms.eli10: Crypto rakhne ki jagah. Actually crypto blockchain pe hoti, wallet me private keys hoti. Kho gayi to crypto gone.
terms.detail: Software (MetaMask, Trust Wallet) or hardware (Ledger, Trezor). Stores private keys. Hot (online) vs cold (offline) wallet.

terms.eli10: 12-24 words jo aapki wallet ka master password. Kisi ko bata diya to wallet khali ho jayega. Likh ke safe rakho.
terms.detail: BIP39 standard. Derives all private keys. Never share. Paper/metal backup. Hardware wallet setup me milti.

terms.eli10: Aapki crypto ka password. Sirf aapke paas. Transaction sign karne ke liye. Share kiya = crypto gone.
terms.detail: 256-bit number. Signs transactions. Derived from seed phrase. Never leaves hardware wallet in good setup.

terms.eli10: Aapka wallet address ban jaata. Log isme paise bhej sakte. Share karne me koi problem nahi.
terms.detail: Derived from private key. Wallet address = hash of public key. Safe to share. Used for receiving.

terms.eli10: Blockchain pe chalne wala program. Automatic rules follow karta. Par bug ya malicious ho sakta — sign karte waqt dhyaan se.
terms.detail: Self-executing code on blockchain. Solidity (Ethereum). Immutable once deployed. Audit critical. Reentrancy, overflow bugs common.

terms.eli10: DApp ko permission dete ho aapke tokens spend karne ki. 'Approve all' kar diya to wallet drain ho sakta.
terms.detail: ERC-20 approve/transferFrom. Phishing: malicious contract gets unlimited approval. Defense: revoke unused (revoke.cash), use hardware wallet.

terms.eli10: Free tokens ka distribution. Par fake airdrops se wallet drain. 'Connect wallet' karwate, malicious sign.
terms.detail: Marketing tactic. Legit (Uniswap, Arbitrum) vs fake (phishing). Real airdrops never ask for seed phrase or 'approve all'.

terms.eli10: Team project launch karti, log paise daalte, fir team bhaag jaati. Liquidity pull. Token worthless.
terms.detail: Common in DeFi/NFT. Developer abandons, drains liquidity. $2.8B+ losses 2021. Defense: research team, check liquidity lock, audit.

terms.eli10: Crypto exchange jaise Binance, Coinbase. Company aapke funds hold karti. Ek hack = users khatre me.
terms.detail: Custodial. User accounts, KYC. Risks: hack, insolvency, freeze. Not your keys, not your crypto.

terms.eli10: Exchange bina company ke. Users direct trade karte smart contract se. Non-custodial.
terms.detail: Uniswap, SushiSwap, PancakeSwap. AMM model. User keeps keys. Risks: smart contract bugs, front-running, impermanent loss.

terms.eli10: Program jo files me attach hota aur khud copy karta. Aap file share karo → doosre ko bhi infect.
terms.detail: Self-replicating, needs host file. Payload: file corruption, spam, backdoor. Older malware style.

terms.eli10: Virus jaisa, par bina host ke khud spread karta. Network me khud copy. WannaCry isi type ka tha.
terms.detail: Self-replicating, no host needed. Network propagation. Morris (1988), ILOVEYOU (2000), WannaCry (2017).

terms.eli10: Asli software jaisa dikhta, actually malware. 'Free antivirus download' karo → actually RAT install.
terms.detail: Disguised as legitimate. No self-replication. Backdoor, RAT, banking trojan. Common in phishing attachments.

terms.eli10: Malware jo hacker ko aapke computer ka poora control deta. Screen dekh sakta, files access, camera on, keystrokes log.
terms.detail: Full remote control. Common: njRAT, Quasar, DarkComet. Delivered via phishing. Detection: unusual network, EDR alerts.

terms.eli10: Aapki files encrypt kar deta, ransom maangta. 'Bitcoin bhejo warna files delete'. Backup se bachao.
terms.detail: Encrypts files. Double extortion (encrypt + leak). Common: LockBit, REvil, Conti. Defense: offline backup, EDR, patching, segmentation.

terms.eli10: Har key press record karta. Passwords, messages sab capture. Software ya hardware (USB) ho sakta.
terms.detail: Software (rootkit-based) or hardware (USB inline). Credentials, banking, PII. Detection: EDR, on-screen keyboard, password manager.

terms.eli10: OS level pe chhupa malware. Detection mushkil. Kabhi-kabhi full reinstall hi solution.
terms.detail: Kernel/user-mode. Hides processes, files, network. Detection: EDR, boot scan. Removal: often reinstall needed.

terms.eli10: Hazaaron infected devices ka network. Hacker command deta, sab milke attack karte. DDoS, spam, crypto mining.
terms.detail: C2-controlled network. Mirai (IoT), Emotet, Necurs. Used for DDoS, spam, credential stuffing, crypto mining.

terms.eli10: Hacker ka remote control. Malware is server se instructions leta. Traffic block karo = botnet dead.
terms.detail: C2/C&C infrastructure. HTTP/DNS/Tor channels. Beaconing pattern. Detection: network anomaly, JA3, threat intel.

terms.eli10: Chhota malware jo asli malware download + install karta. First stage.
terms.detail: Initial payload. Fetches second-stage malware. Evades AV. Common in phishing attachments.

terms.eli10: Dropper jaisa — malware ko memory me load karta. Disk pe nahi likhta, detection mushkil.
terms.detail: In-memory execution. Reflective DLL injection. Common: Emotet, TrickBot, SmokeLoader. Evades file-based AV.

terms.eli10: Asli malicious kaam karne wala part. Encryption, exfiltration, backdoor. Dropper/Loader isko deliver karte.
terms.detail: Final-stage code. Ransomware encryption, RAT functionality, data theft. Delivered by dropper/loader.

terms.eli10: Bug ka faayda uthane wala code. Software ki weakness se code chalana. Zero-day = unknown bug.
terms.detail: Weaponized vulnerability. RCE, privilege escalation, DoS. Delivered via phishing, drive-by, exploit kits.

terms.eli10: Computer jo quantum physics use karta — classical se hazaar guna fast for specific problems. Crypto todne me capable.
terms.detail: Qubits, superposition, entanglement. Shor's algorithm breaks RSA/ECC. Timeline: 2030-2035 for cryptographic threat.

terms.eli10: Quantum algorithm jo bade numbers ko fast factor karta. RSA isi pe depend karta — toot jayega.
terms.detail: Peter Shor (1994). Polynomial time factoring. Breaks RSA, ECC, Diffie-Hellman. Requires large-scale quantum computer.

terms.eli10: Quantum-safe algorithms. NIST ne 2024 me standard banaye. Abhi migrate karna zaroori.
terms.detail: NIST standards: ML-KEM (Kyber), ML-DSA (Dilithium), SLH-DSA (SPHINCS+), FN-DSA (Falcon). Lattice + hash-based.

terms.eli10: NIST-approved quantum-safe key exchange (FIPS 203). Purana 'Kyber' naam. Chrome, Signal use kar rahe.
terms.detail: Lattice-based KEM. Key size reasonable. NIST FIPS 203 (2024). Hybrid mode with X25519 in browsers.

terms.eli10: Quantum-safe signatures (FIPS 204). Purana 'Dilithium'. Certificates ke liye.
terms.detail: Lattice-based signatures. FIPS 204 (2024). Larger signatures than RSA. Code signing, TLS certs migration.

terms.eli10: Quantum-safe signatures ka doosra option (FIPS 205). 'SPHINCS+' naam tha. Slower but conservative.
terms.detail: Hash-based. FIPS 205 (2024). Very conservative security. Larger + slower signatures. Backup option.

terms.eli10: Attacker aaj encrypted traffic copy kar raha. Quantum computer aane pe decrypt karega. Isliye aaj hi migrate karo.
terms.detail: Long-term threat. Encrypted data stored for future decryption. Migration urgency. NIST/CISA recommend hybrid PQC now.

terms.eli10: Quantum computer ka basic unit. 0 ya 1 ke bajaye 0 aur 1 dono ek saath (superposition). Isse parallel computation.
terms.detail: Quantum information unit. Superposition + entanglement. Fragile (decoherence). IBM, Google, IonQ race.

terms.eli10: Europe ka data law. Aapki personal data kis tarah handle hogi. Breach pe 72 hours me notify karna.
terms.detail: EU regulation (2018). Data subject rights, consent, DPO, breach notification. Fines up to €20M or 4% revenue.

terms.eli10: India ka data protection law (2023). Consent-based. Kuch rights + company duties.
terms.detail: India (2023). Consent + purpose limitation. Data Fiduciary + Data Principal. Penalty up to ₹250 Cr. Rules notified 2025.

terms.eli10: India ka cyber law. Hacking, identity theft, phishing — sab covered. Section 66, 66C, 66D important.
terms.detail: India cyber law. Sections: 43 (unauthorized access), 66 (computer offenses), 66C (identity theft), 66D (cheating).

terms.eli10: Kisi ki electronic signature/password use karna = identity theft. 3 saal jail + ₹1 lakh fine.
terms.detail: Punishment: 3 years + ₹1 lakh fine. Covers password, digital signature, unique ID theft.

terms.full: IT Act Section 66D - Cheating by Personation
terms.eli10: Electronic media se dhokha dena — jaise phishing, vishing. 3 saal jail + ₹1 lakh fine.
terms.detail: Cheating using computer resource or communication device. Phishing covered. 3 years + ₹1 lakh.

terms.eli10: India ka cyber emergency team. Security incidents report karo. 6 hours me notify karna (2022 rules).
terms.detail: Established 2004. Incident reporting mandatory. 2022 rules: 6-hour window for critical incidents. cert-in.org.in.

terms.eli10: International security standard. Company certify karwati — batati ki security serious hai. Global recognition.
terms.detail: ISMS framework. Risk-based controls. Certification audit (BSI, TÜV). Common requirement in enterprise sales.

terms.eli10: US standard SaaS companies ke liye. 5 trust principles — security, availability, confidentiality, privacy, integrity.
terms.detail: AICPA framework. Type I (point-in-time) or Type II (period). Required by US enterprise customers.

terms.eli10: Software me bug jo developer ko nahi pata. Patch nahi hai. Attacker use kar sakta — defense mushkil.
terms.detail: Unknown vulnerability. Sold for $100k-$2.5M on gray market. Defended by EDR + behavior analysis + patching fast.

terms.eli10: Har vulnerability ka unique ID (jaise CVE-2024-12345). Global database. Patch level track karta.
terms.detail: MITRE-managed. Unique identifier. Public disclosure. cve.mitre.org. Basis for CVSS scoring.

terms.eli10: Vulnerability kitni serious hai — 0 to 10. 9+ critical, 7+ high. Priority set karne me help.
terms.detail: Score: 0.0-10.0. Vector: attack complexity, privileges, user interaction. CVSS 4.0 (2023) latest.

terms.eli10: Compromise ke signs — malicious IP, domain, file hash. Threat intel me share karte. Defense me use.
terms.detail: Technical artifacts: IP, domain, URL, hash, registry key. Fast to detect, fast to change by attacker. Combine with TTP.

terms.eli10: Behavior based sign — attacker ka pattern. IOC se zyada durable. Prevention me better.
terms.detail: Focus on intent + behavior (not artifacts). Harder for attacker to change. Used in EDR, XDR.

terms.eli10: Sab jagah jahan se attacker aa sakta — websites, apps, employees, servers. Zyada surface = zyada risk.
terms.detail: External (websites, APIs) + internal (users, apps). Reducing surface = better security. Attack Surface Management (ASM) tools.

terms.eli10: Attacker ek system se doosre pe jaata. Initial access ke baad andar failta. Zero Trust isse rokta.
terms.detail: Post-exploitation phase. Credential reuse, RDP, SMB, PsExec. Detected by UEBA, segmentation, EDR.

terms.eli10: Attacker normal user se admin ban jaata. Zyada control mil jaata. Kernels bugs, misconfigs use karta.
terms.detail: Vertical (user→admin) or horizontal (user→user). Exploits: kernel bugs, SUID binaries, misconfigured services.

terms.eli10: Attacker data chupke bahar bhejta. DNS, HTTPS, cloud storage me. Detect karna mushkil.
terms.detail: Data theft egress. Covert channels (DNS tunneling, steganography). DLP + egress monitoring defense.

terms.eli10: Attacker system pe rehne ka tareeka — reboot pe bhi. Registry, scheduled task, cron job.
terms.detail: Maintain access. Registry Run keys, services, scheduled tasks, WMI, startup folder. Detection: Autoruns, EDR.

terms.eli10: Malware regular interval pe C2 server ko call karta. 'Aap kaam kya karne ka' poochta. Traffic pattern se detect.
terms.detail: Periodic C2 check-in. Jitter to evade detection. Analysis: network flow, JA3, DNS queries.

terms.eli10: Ethical hackers jo company ko attack karke test karte. Real attacker jaisa. Findings se defense improve.
terms.detail: Offensive simulation. Full-scope adversarial. Compare to blue team (defense). Purple = collaboration.

terms.eli10: Defenders — SOC analysts, incident responders. Attack detect karke rok dete.
terms.detail: Defense: monitoring, detection, response, hardening. Tools: SIEM, EDR, XDR, SOAR.

terms.eli10: Company reward deti ethical hackers ko — bug dhoondo, report karo, paisa lo. HackerOne, Bugcrowd platforms.
terms.detail: Crowdsourced security testing. Ranges: $50-$1M+ per bug. Google, Apple, Microsoft programs.

terms.eli10: Bug mila to company ko pehle batao (private). Fix hone ke baad public. 90 days common window.
terms.detail: CVD process. Researcher → vendor → fix → public. Google Project Zero 90-day policy.
